title: Require exact persistence policy booleans
description: P3 security/API review: AnnounceStatePersistence.allow_bootstrap, TwoSlotFilePersistence.fail_closed, and DaoManager.require_crash_safety are policy controls but accept coercive integers/objects at runtime. Truthy non-booleans can authorize bootstrap or claim fail-closed operation, while falsey non-booleans disable enforcement. Require exact bool values at construction and add coercive configuration tests.
